page_estimates.accounting: rounded estimates derived from matching /proc/PID/smaps KiB totals; shared/private reflect smaps classifications, not guest-physical page positions; PSS is excluded because it apportions shared pages

smoke_test.record_kind: synthesized same-user clone registry record attached to a live QEMU process
smoke_test.qemu_state: QEMU was started with -S; the guest had not executed and no template pages were resident in the matching mapping
smoke_test.purpose: validate clone registry lookup, PID/start-time/boot-ID checks, QEMU command-line RAM-file discovery, and output formatting
smoke_test.not_evidence_of: a persistent DenseVM clone start, guest RAM sharing, or COW behavior
